objective: Build a read-only Application Inbox / Status Monitor that can ingest application/recruiter status signals, reconcile them with Career Ops canonical application state and regional trackers, and surface owner-action items without sending mail.
prerequisites: Career Ops dedupe/application-state interface should be stable.
allowed_scope: Prefer an existing Gmail/API integration if already present locally; otherwise build the adapter/interface and leave owner OAuth/login as an exact afternoon step.
Read-only only: classify application acknowledgements, rejections, interview/invite/follow-up signals, recruiter messages and unknowns with provenance.
Map signals to canonical company/job/application records using conservative matching and require human review when ambiguous.
Update a safe local status store/tracker interface idempotently; never invent an application if no evidence exists.
Generate a concise Chief summary of changed statuses and owner actions.
Test on fixtures/sanitized samples if live access is unavailable; clearly distinguish fixture evidence from live evidence.
Record any owner OAuth/account requirement in the owner-action TODO.
notes: Part of the owner-mandated 2026-09-24 morning engineering cutoff. Continue independently around owner-only credential/admin blockers; record those in tasks-or-issues/overnight-owner-actions-2026-09-24.md. Do not duplicate equivalent pending/running work.

result.summary: Built the read-only Application Inbox / Status Monitor. career-ops/application_inbox.py deterministically classifies application/recruiter signals (acknowledgement, rejection, interview invite, assessment invite, follow-up request, offer, recruiter outreach, else unknown) with quoted-reply stripping, priority ordering and contradiction -> unknown+human review; matches conservatively against the four canonical Career Ops workbooks by verbatim posting URL or explicit canonical reference (high) or company+title agreement (medium), treats a company-only match as ALWAYS ambiguous with candidates listed, and never creates an application record (unmatched -> review queue, nothing invented). Status is mapped only into each region's own vocabulary (drift-tested against regional_profiles.json validations); where a region has no accurate equivalent (assessment invites anywhere, Japan rejections, Dubai offers) no status is proposed and the owner decides; a proposal for a row whose tracker records no application yet is flagged requires_owner_confirmation with the reason recorded. Writes an idempotent local store (signals.jsonl by signal_id, status-events.jsonl by region+row+kind, derived current-state.json with no run timestamp, append-only run-log) and a concise Chief summary of changed statuses, owner actions and review items; Excel remains authoritative and state_written is always false. Adapters: local_mailbox implemented+tested (.eml/.mbox/.json/.jsonl incl. Gmail API payloads with base64 bodies/.csv; .md/.txt skipped, not guessed); gmail_readonly (career-ops/gmail_readonly.py) is an interface + credential-presence probe with a refusing fetch - gmail.readonly scope only, disabled, no credentials, and its untested HTTP path is reported UNVERIFIED/fetch_path_executed:false, never as working. No send/reply/forward/archive/delete/move/label/mark-read path exists; guard refuses and logs each. Verified: 87 new tests pass (207 in career-ops/tests, 0 failures); acceptance runner 33/33 checks PASS with canonical workbook SHA-256s unchanged, store byte-identical on replay with zero new signals, 0 workbook writes, 0 applications created, all mailbox mutations refused, no credential contents reported. Live evidence: NOT claimed - no live mailbox was read.
result.owner_action_required: Optional, ~10 minutes, only needed for the LIVE mailbox feed (the monitor works today on a local export directory): complete the Gmail read-only OAuth step - enable Gmail API, create a Desktop-app OAuth client, save its JSON to C:\Users\mukun\AppData\Local\hermes\secrets\gmail-readonly\credentials.json, authorise scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly once, save the refresh token to token.json, then set adapters.gmail_readonly.enabled=true and run 'python career-ops/application_inbox.py adapters' (must report available:true). Exact steps are in tasks-or-issues/overnight-owner-actions-2026-09-24.md item 9. Separately, item 10 asks whether you want Assessment / Japan-Rejected / Dubai-Offer statuses added to the tracker vocabularies, or prefer those to keep arriving as owner decisions.
